name: CHARM
summary: CHARM was a CERN SPS neutrino programme studying leptonic and semileptonic weak interactions, including precision neutrino-electron scattering and beam-dump searches.
physics_targets: Prompt neutrinos, heavy neutral leptons and oscillation tests
detection_principle: A fine-grained low-density sampling calorimeter reconstructed electromagnetic and hadronic showers, followed by muon identification. Very forward single-electron events isolated neutrino-electron scattering from the much larger neutrino-nucleon background.
